messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's vendor outage (cloud auth + model-registry flakiness). Posting owners/timeline so we don't lose the momentum.
frank: thanks — can we put owners + firm dates? I can take cloud fallback automation.
maya: owners: cloud fallback automation -> frank (ETA 2026-04-05). model-registry retry + token rotation -> devon (ETA 2026-03-29). auth provider circuit + alerts -> rachel (ETA 2026-04-02). exec/SLA sync -> liam (ETA 2026-04-01).
devon: taking model-registry work. plan: add idempotent retry, refresh tokens on 401, and a short-circuit escape to avoid thundering herd. PR by Wed.
rachel: I'll build a circuit-breaker and improve alert contexts (include vendor request_id + latency histogram). adding playbook entry for on-call.
liam: I'll own the vendor SLA conversation and the exec note. will schedule vendor call for next Tue.
maya: ops-bot created tracker tasks: https://tickets.local/INC-4472,INC-4473,INC-4474
ops-bot: Task INC-4472 assigned to frank; INC-4473 assigned to devon; INC-4474 assigned to rachel.
devon: small dependency: model-registry client currently caches tokens for 24h. need short-lived rotation for prod flows — adding as subtask on INC-4473.
frank: Cloud fallback plan note: want a dry-run in prod with 5% traffic diverted to fallback for 1h. propose 2026-04-03 10:00 PT.
rachel: +1. I'll coordinate with oncall and add steps to the playbook for rollback.
maya: Pattern observed: auth provider latency spikes every ~6 weeks, often preceding cascade to model-registry. Recommend monthly synthetic test and SLA threshold alert.
liam: I'll add a recurring vendor resilience review and a quarterly runbook drill. Tentatively assigning first run to maya.
maya: assign to-me confirmed — running first drill on 2026-04-10.
devon: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1291 — includes retry/backoff and token refresh hooks.
frank: please add a CI test that mocks vendor 503 to ensure fallback is exercised (infra/ci).
devon: will add. test sketch: 
```
# pseudo-python
mock_vendor.return_status(503)
client.call_model()
assert fallback_endpoint_called()
```
rachel: after runbook update I'll ping platform leads to schedule canary and link to the drill.
maya: :white_check_mark: I'll update the postmortem doc with the timeline + owners and link to the INCs.
liam: thanks all. reassign if blocked. leaving thread open until all INCs show closed.
maya: leaving open and moving tasks to #incidents-triage board. ping me if anything slips.
